_README.description: Custom-provider model registry for the simulator's CI run (.github/workflows/simulator.yml).
_README.why_not_conf: conf/*_models.json is the shipped registry, audited against live provider catalogs by scripts/audit_model_registry.py. This entry describes a model that exists only inside a CI job, so it is kept out of that directory to stay out of the audit.
_README.usage: CUSTOM_MODELS_CONFIG_PATH=simulator_tests/conf/ci_custom_models.json with CUSTOM_API_URL pointing at a local Ollama, and SIMULATOR_MODEL=ci-local.

models.description: Llama 3.2 1B served by Ollama in CI - smallest model that answers over the wire
